lvlText.high: {n} of {all} actions are classed as dangerous.
lvlText.highAll: Covers every access class, dangerous ones included.
lvlText.elevated: {n} of {all} actions are far-reaching: admin or unclassified.
lvlText.medium: Can create and change data, nothing dangerous.

lvlTextNoCount.elevated: Includes far-reaching actions: admin or unclassified.

newNone: Nothing new: everything is allowed today already.
newUnknownText: ToolMesh could not count the tools of this kit.
durText: from the approval, then it ends on its own
fpHint: Compare it with the fingerprint the agent gave you. If they match, this page shows its request.
claimLabel: Reason, as the requester states it
claimNote: In the requester’s own words, not translated. ToolMesh does not verify it.
techSub: The kit’s {n} entries, the connection and the times
scopeHint: Switch off what the task does not need. The grant covers only what stays on.

groupDesc.all: Every tool, dangerous and admin ones included.
groupDesc.dangerous: Can delete or overwrite data for good.
groupDesc.unclassified: Can do anything the API allows.

eGrantAnyBackend: Every tool in this class, on every backend
noSigners: Nobody can approve this kit here yet: none of the approvers allowed to approve it has a signing address. Add one under approvers: in config/authz.yaml, see “Set up a signing key” below.
ctaNone: Switch on at least one entry
keyNote: Your private key never leaves this page. Only the signature is sent.
signHint: Your signature covers exactly this approval, and only once.
stmtShow: Show the exact text you sign
keyLabel: Your signing key, for example from your password manager (WIF or 64 hex characters). It stays in this page.
keyOk: This key belongs to {addr}, the address of {name}.
keyBad: This key belongs to {addr}, not to the address of {name}.
keyInvalid: This is not a private key: use WIF or 64 hex characters.
insecure: This page is not served over HTTPS, so someone on the network could change it. Do not enter a key here; sign in your wallet.
walletHint: Copy the exact text into a wallet that signs BIP-322 messages for your bc1q address, then paste the signature here.
doneLead: {user} can now use the kit {kit} for {ttl}.
closeNote: You can close this window now.
goneTitle: This request is no longer open
goneText: It lapsed or has been decided already. If the task still needs it, ask the agent for a new request.
failedTitle: The request could not be loaded
failedText: ToolMesh could not read it right now. Try again in a moment.
setupLead: Approvers sign with the key of a bc1q address. Make one here: it is made in this page and sent nowhere.
setupText: Keep the private key in your password manager and add the address to {file}:
setupHint: ToolMesh applies changes to {file} within seconds. A key from a wallet works too: use the address of a native SegWit (bc1q…) account.
footServed: Served by ToolMesh. Your key never leaves this page.
